sanskrit: aṣṭādaśavidhaṃ devi jñānañca kulagocarecandradvīpavinirgate prathamaḥ paṭalaḥsṛṣṭiyogaṃ mayā jñātaṃ saṃhāraṃ kathayasva mekālāgnirudrasaṃjñā tu nakhāgre nityasaṃsthitamvaḍavāmukhamahattvañca pātāle sahasaṃsthitaḥetāni kathitā bhadre bhuvanāni caturdaśasarvajñā (yatna ?) saṃlīnaṃ layañca śaktigocarejñānamadhye kriyā līnā kriyā līyati icchayāsaṃhārantu imaṃ bhedena kathitantava śobhanesṛṣṭiyogaṃ padānyastaṃ sṛjatyevaṃ carācarampūrvaṃ yat sūcitaṃ devi sṛṣṭiyogaṃ mayā tavakimanyaṃ pṛcchase nāthe sugopyaṃ prakaṭīkṛtamcandradvīpavinirgate dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥetanme saṃśayo nātha prasādībhava śaṅkaraḥyatra dṛṣṭirmanastatra bhūtendriyamapudgalaḥsthānaṃ dhyānañca varṇañca lakṣañcaiva catuṣṭayamvarṇarūpaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ lakṣaṃ vai rūpavarjitamsthāne sthāne sthitandevi ekaikasya caturvidhampañcāraṃ ṣoḍaśārañca catuḥṣaṣṭidalampriyekoṭipatraṃ sutejāḍhyaṃ tasyorddhe anyathā śṛṇukarṇikākeśarairyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ (tathaiva ca)svātantramabjamacalaṃ sarvavyāpī nirañjanamtena liṅgantu vikhyātaṃ yatra līnaṃ carācaramajñātvā bandhamuddiṣṭaṃ jñātvā bandhaiḥ pramucyatepratyakṣaṃ sarvadā nityaṃ atasipuṣpasannibham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānagamyaṃ sadā devi pāramparyakramāgatamna kāṣṭhaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ liṅgaṃ na śailaratnasambhavamsphaṭikaṃ maulikaṃ vāpi trapuṃ sīsakatāmrajamaṣṭādaśa lokaśāstrāṇi krurāścādhyātmikāstathākiṃ kāraṇaṃ mahādevi paśavo jñānavarjitāḥna taistu saṅgabhoktavyaṃ na kuryāddravyasaṃgrahamyakṣagāndharvasiddhāśca tṛṇagulmapipīlikāḥniṣkrāntā bindumadhye tu laulībhūtantu tatsamamsphurantan nirmalannityaṃ aprameyaṃ sadoditametalliṅgavaraṃ jñātvā dṛṣṭvā mokṣasya bhājanaḥna naśyedagninā liṅgaṃ na pated vajratāḍitamarcayenmānasaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhairdhūpadīpitaiḥtṛtīyantu dayāpuṣpambhāvapuṣpañcaturthakamsaptamaṃ dhyānapuṣpantu jñānapuṣpantu aṣṭamambhuktimuktimavāpnoti dehaliṅgārcanena tumanoliṅgaṃ sadā dhyāyed yāṃ yāṃ phalasamīkṛteetat te kaulikandevi dehaliṅgasya lakṣaṇamlaukikam mārgasampannā siddhimuktivivarjitābahisthā vāsanā yasya saḥ paśuraṅgarañjitaḥdātavyaṃ bhaktisaṃyukte na deyaṃ bhaktivarjitecandradvīpavinirgate tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥadya me nirmalandehaṃ tvatprasādena bhairavanigrahānugrahañcaiva krāmaṇaṃ haraṇaṃ tathākathaṃ me sarvasaṃkṣepāttvameva śaraṇaṅgatākulapiṇḍaṃ samālikhya nāḍī nāḍīmukhaiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāḍī nāḍīmukhairvāpi adhorddhaṃ rephadīpitamjanmamaṇḍalasaṃlīnaṃ dhvāntateja(ḥ)samaprabhamkarastobhādikaṃ bhadre karotyevaṃ carācaraiḥjanmamanḍalasaṃlīnaṃ dhvāntateja(ḥ)samaprabhamdhyātvā vidyullatākāraṃ śaktirvai vyomapañcakeśaktivijñānavedhena manākhyena mahānmaneparadehe parāśaktirnādenākramya vedhayetatītānāgatañcaiva pṛṣṭāsau kathayiṣyatiśaṃkhābhiṣekavijñānaṃ dantakāṣṭhādikampriyemāraṇoccāṭanañcaiva stambhamohādikaṃ priyepañcāśavarṇasaṃyogaṃ jñātvā sarvaṃ kuru priyekurute vibhidaṃ karma yaddevi manasepsitamyojayettāṃ kulādhā(raṃ)tu sarvaṃ jñātvā dṛḍhalakṣavitsvātantro muktimāyāti sarvahṛdbhavane tu saḥyat tvayāpṛcchitambhadre sugopya siddhikāraṇamna deyaṃ bhaktihīnasya kaulikīṃ siddhimicchatāmcandradvīpavinirgate caturthaḥ paṭalaḥkathayasva mahādeva bhrāntinirnāśanaṃ paramsarvadvandvavinirmukta sa gatābhyāsatatparaḥuttiṣṭha khaḍgapātālaṃ rocanāñjanapādukamantarddhānambhaveddevi tathānyañca rasāyanamśṛṇu tvaṃ ekacittantu kathyamānaṃ mayā priyecandrāhlādakaraṃ divyaṃ āgacchantaṃ khamadhyataḥna jarāmaraṇantasya vyādhirogo na vidyatekṣīrodārṇavamadhyasthaṃ śvetaṃ kamalavistaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmiṃścaiva niviṣṭaṃ tu sitābharaṇabhūṣitamkṣīrodavi(śe)ṣaiḥ sarvaissiñcyamānamanusmaretkrīḍate vividhairbhogairicchārūpañca jāyatedhyātvā candrāsanasthañca ūrddhaścandreṇa ghaṭṭitamjarāmaraṇanirmuktaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitamanyañca adbhutandevi śṛṇu tvaṃ kulabhāvinidhyāyamānamidandevi jarāvyādhirvinaśyatidhyāyeccandramidaṃ devi nābhimūrdhni ca hṛdgatamtataḥ svātantramāyāti jarāmaraṇavarjitamsahasradalaśobhāḍhyaṃ gokṣīradhavalopamamadhaścakrasamārūḍhaṃ ūrddhacakreṇa plāvitamvalīpalitanirmuktaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitamanyadapyadbhūtaṃ devi śṛṇutaikāgramānasamsthāne sthāne tu taṃ dhyātvā śivādyāvīcigocaramniṣkrāntaṃ romakūpa iśca gokṣīrahimasannibhamsvātantraḥ śivatulyastu svacchandagaticeṣṭitaḥguhyanābhihṛdi kaṇṭhe vaktre mūrdhni śikhāntareekādaśavidhā devi cakrāṇi ca sahasrikāṣoḍaśaṃ śatapatrañca koṭipatraṃ yathaiva caraktaṃ vaśyaṃ sadā devi mahābhogapradāyakamśuklamāpyāyane proktaṃ viśeṣaṃ śāntikārakamtaptacāmīkaraprabhaṃ purakṣobhādikāraṇamdharmārthau kāmamokṣau ca aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakambhavatyevaṃ na sandeho abhyāsāt tadgatasya tuamaratvaṃ bhaveddevi jayenmṛtyuṃ na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gopitavyaṃ prayatnena martyaloke narādhamedātavyaṃ pūrvasiddhasya abdamekaparīkṣitamcandradvīpavinirgate pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥtvatprasādena kauleśa jñāto'haṃ kaulanirṇayaḥko'sau jīvaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ kiṃ vā jīvasvarūpakamkasmiṃścaiva layaṃ yāti tatsarvaṃ kathayasva mesa(ḥ)paraṃ niṣkalaṃ nityaṃ nirāmayanirañjanamsa(ḥ) jīvaḥ parataro yastu sa(ḥ) haṃsaḥ śaktipudgala(ḥ)samīrapūrako vāyuḥ sarvajīveṣu saṃsthitam(ḥ)sa dehatyaktamātreṇa paraṃ śivo nigadyatekarṇasthaṃ śrūyate devi pāramparyakramāgatamanena jñānamātreṇa śrutena ca varānaneṣaṇmāsādabhyasedyastu kāṣāyaṃ bandhavarjitamsarvavyādhivinirmukto yogibhiḥ sahamelakametatte jīvamabhyāsaṃ kathitaṃ te ca bhairavisarvabhāvopapannasya dātavyaṃ kṛtaniścayena deyaṃ kaulikaṃ sāraṃ yoginīnāntu sambhavamadya me nirmalaṃ dehamajñānapaṭalāhatamsāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi kālasya vañcanaṃ śubhamkathayāmi na sandeho yathā mṛtyurvinaśyatiamṛtāgraṃ rasāgreṇa dahyamānasudhīrapirasanātālumūle tu kṛtvā vāyuṃ pibecchanaiḥabdamekaṃ yadābhyastañjarāmṛtyurvinaśyativiṣaṃ na kramate dehe daṃśito'pi mahoragaiḥchedyamāno na chidyeta tadgato tanmano yathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛtaṃ taṃ vijānīyādbalīpalitanāśanambalīpalitanirmuktaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥrasanā tālumūle tu vyādhināśāya yojayetrasanaṃ kuñcayennityaṃ svavaktreṇa tu saṃyutamhṛdisthañca manaḥ kṛtvā yāvadunmanatāṃ gataḥkālasya vañcanaṃ devi sugopyaṃ prakaṭīkṛtamcandradvīpavinirgate ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥtritattvaṃ katha me nātha tvameva śaraṇaṃ gatādevyāścakragataṃ cintya(?) pratipadāyāṃ śaśiryathātatra caiva śikhā līnā asthicakre varānanesādravaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ ca balīpalitanāśanamādhāraskandhasaṃsthāne yogaṃ yuñjīta śītalamādityaṃ śatruvat paśyet somaṃ vai mitravad yathābhūgṛhe nirjane sthāne daṃśamaśakavarjiteekānte nirjane divye puṣpaprakaraṇaśobhiteṣaṇmāsāj jñāyate siddhiryoginīpadatatsamaḥbrahmagranthisthitādyetāṃ trīṇi eva varānanedraveṇa rañjayet sarvaṃ romakūpādikaṃ priyebhavatyevanna sandehaḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tusādravaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇañca ṣoḍaśasvarabhūṣitamṣaṇmāsāsevanābhyastād vṛddho'pi taruṇāyateyoginīsthānamāśritya asitaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakamkeśaskandhakapālasthaṃ rañjayet tasya tejasājarāmaraṇanirmukto vyādhirogavivarjitaḥkaṇṭhakūpasthitodyotaṃ brahmarandhralayaṃ gatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anaṅgasyaiva saubhāgyaṃ nigūḍhaṃ sandhibandhanamprathame janavācchalyaṃ dvitīye rujanāśanamcaturthe vācakāmitvaṃ dūrāśravaṇaṃ pañcameyoginīmelakatvañca saptame jāyate dhruvamnavame caṇḍavegatvaṃ daśame'nekarūpadhṛkekādaśaguṇopetaṃ pūjyate'sau yathā śivamyatastatraiva gantavyaṃ yatra vā rocate manaḥprapañcarahitaṃ śāstraṃ prapañcarahito guruḥetat kaulāgamaṃ nātha aprapañcaiḥ paśuḥ priyekecidajñānato naṣṭāḥ kecinnaṣṭāḥ pramādataḥkampastobhe tathā roṣā mudrāmutpatanantathāyāṃ yāṃ spṛśati hastena yāṃ yāṃ paśyati cakṣuṣāpalitastambhavijñānaṃ kathitaṃ yoginīpriyeetante kathitaṃ guhyaṃ unmanajñānanirṇitiḥcandradvīpavinirgate saptamaḥ paṭamaḥakule tu kulaṃ devaṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ hi bhairavasahajā kulajā vāpi aṣṭāṣṭakamatantathāgurupūjāvidhānantu sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato vadaekānte vijane sthāne puṣpadāmopaśobhitebhakṣyabhojyasamāyukto madirānandasaṃyutamantyajā vā mahādevi pṛthagbhedaṃ vadāmyahamkulajā veśyamityāhurantyajāvarṇa antyajāgamyāgamyaprayogeṇa madanānandalakṣaṇamkulajā kiṃ na vijñātā varṇarāśikulātmikāmantyajā saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathāsthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrddhatīryaksaṃśuddhā mahāśakti sutejasātāmbulapūritaṃ vaktraṃ viliptaṃ muktamena cayoginīvīrasaṃyuktaṃ yugmapātraṃ pṛthak pṛthakraktāmbaradharāḥ sarve keyūrakaṭakojjvalāḥitthambhūtaṃ kulācāryaḥ kulaputrairadhiṣṭhitamkaravīraṃ mahākālaṃ devikoṭyaṃ varānaneteṣāṃ madhye pradhānantu ye jātāḥ kṣetrajā priyecaturyugeṣu deveśi kṣetrajā siddhipūjitākṣetrajā kathitā devi pīṭhajā(ḥ) kathayāmi teupapīṭhasthitā sapta devīnāṃ siddha-ālayamoḍiyāna mahāpīṭhamupapīṭhasamanvitampīṭhādyādevatānāṃ ca śṛṇu pūjāvidhiṃ priyeetaistu pūjitā bhadre sarve sidhyanti mātarāḥyogena yogajā mātā mantreṇa mantrajā priyebhakṣitaṃ tu caruṃ divyaṃ saptajanmāntikaṃ paśumgarbhe jātena deveśi garbhaṃ jānanti ātmanaḥvārāhī vajrahastā ca tathā yogeśvarīti catathānyā dvārapālinyā taistu saṃvyāpitañjagatsarvāstāṃ pūjayennityaṃ gurusiddhasamanvitāmkulāṣṭakaṃ pravakṣyāmi aṣṭāṣṭakavidhi priyeyathā etat tathā sarve jñātavyā yoginīkramamyoginīmelakaṃ cakraṃ aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakamdvitīyantu mahācakraṃ sarvākṛṣṭipravartakamtṛtīyantu mahācakraṃ parakāyapraveśanamlabhatyeva na sandeho vividhaṃ yat samīhitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayitvā imaṃ cakraṃ yāvad dhyānaṃ prayuñjatibhāṣāstu vividhākārā aśrutāni śrutāni casvayamevātmanātmane śrūyate cātmanātmanibalīpalitanirmuktaḥ kāmadevo dvitīyakaḥvāyvādernāśayedvācā mūkavat tiṣṭhate tu saḥsaptamañcakraṃ deveśi sainyastambhakaraṃ paramdūrācca darśanaṃ tasmin pūjādhyānaratasya tumāraṇoccāṭanaṃ bhadre stambhamohādikaṃ priyeaṣṭāṣṭakavidhānantu jñātvā sidhyati nānyathāniḥsandigdhaṃ mayā proktaṃ hi bhaktiyuktyāvadhāramcandradvīpavinirgate aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥyoginīpañktivinyāsaṃ kathayāmi tava priyesarvabhūcarīsarvagocarayoginīnāṃ sarvakṣetrakamsarvasahajāḥ sarvakulajā sarvadvārapālikāḥguhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyantava bhaktyā prakāśitamsāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi gurubhyaḥ siddhapūjanamakṣaradvayavinyāsamanyanteṣu pradāpayetanena sadṛśaṃ jñānaṃ na bhūyo na bhaviṣyatiteṣāṃ nāmavidhiṃ vakṣye śṛṇu tvaṃ varalocanecaturyugeti deveśa svatantra - kulacodakā (ḥ)daśakoṭipramāṇantu i(da)m kaulaṃ parodbhavamicchākhyā yoginī siddhairmāyāntaṃ para-icchayāmātarāṇāṃ punardevi khecaraiḥ kathitaṃ priyebhūcarīṇāṃ subhakṣāṇāṃ bhūcarī kathitaṃ priyecaturaśīti sahasreṣu yoniyantreṣu pīḍitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhuktimuktimahāsiddhiḥ yoginīnāṃ priyo bhavetcandradvīpavinirgate navamaḥ paṭalaḥvahnināveṣṭitātmānamekapādena saṃsthitamjñānasya nirṇayandeva adya me prakaṭīkṛtamaṣṭāṣṭakavibhāgantu parijñātumanantathāguhyasthānaṃ yathācakraṃ kṣipraṃ sidhyati bhairavasādhu sādhu mahādevi pṛṣṭo'haṃ suradurlabhamkṣakāraṃ brahmarandhratvaṃ laṃkārantu lalāṭayoḥṣakāraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe tu śakāraṃ hṛdaye tadāsthānacakrāstu saṃproktāsteṣāṃ dhyānaṃ śṛṇu priyeaṣṭāraṃ paṅkajaṃ divyaṃ prathamāṣṭakabhūṣitamabhyāsāt samacittastu grāmadharmañca varjayetdūrāśravaṇavijñānaṃ pāśastobhantathā priyeamaratvantathā devi samāsāt parivartanamdvitīyamaṣṭapatrantu tejadhyānasudīpitamkurute bahudhā rūpaṃ dhyānaikagatacetasaḥkruddhastu saṃharet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaramtṛtīyantu mahācakraṃ navatattvapramocakaḥbalīpalitanāśantu sudūrāddarśanantathāekānte bahudhā rūpaṃ kuru dhyānañca tatparaḥkurute amaratvaṃ hi satatābhyāsatatparaḥdivasānnāśanenaiva vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyatesatatābhyāsayogena dviraṣṭavarṣākṛtirbhavetdhūmravarṇaṃ sadā cintya trailokyaṃ cālayet priyeṣaṣṭhaṃ tu cakraṃ rājānamaṣṭapatrasakarṇikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: atītānāgatañcaiva aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakamsaptamantu mahādevi pūrṇacandraprabhaṃ priyejarāmṛtyuvināśañca paradehe praveśanamaṣṭamantu mahācakraṃ patrāṣṭakavibhūṣitamraktadhyāne sadāvaśyaṃ pītastambhakaraṃ paramkṛṣṇena māraṇaṃ proktaṃ dhūmramuccāṭane sadāpuraḥkṣobhantatastobhaṃ kampapātādikaṃ caretekaikasya sthitandevi etaddhyānantu aṣṭadhāadya me saphalaṃ jātammahākauleṣu bhairavacandradvīpavinirgate daśamaḥ paṭalaḥsarvaśaṅkāvinirmuktaṃ niḥśaṅkaṃ sidhyate dhruvamkathayāmi niḥsandehaṃ sarvaśaṅkāvimardakaḥdvaitantu kārayedyastu ākṛṣṭo yogibhistu saḥdvaitabhāvaṃ parityajya advaitācārabhāvitaḥjñātavyaṃ kulasamayaṃ kulaputrairviśeṣataḥanuṣṭhitamidaṃ pūrvaṃ kulasiddhaiḥ sulocaneyadicchet kaulavī siddhiḥ prāpya pañcāmṛtaṃ paramdadante ca tadā devi carukaṃ pañcabhiryutamatha vā prāśayejjñātvā yogayuktastu kaulavityoginīgaṇasāmānyāmanaḥ sucintitaṃ bhavetetat pañca pavitrāṇi nityameva kulāgamegomāṃsaṃ goghṛtaṃ raktaṃ gokṣīrañca dadhintathāniḥśaṅko nirvikalpastu etat kuryāt kulāgamepunaranyaviśeṣaṇaṃ śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥkūrmakacchavarāhañca mārjāravakakarkaṭam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śerakañca mṛgaṃ vāpi mahiṣaṃ gaṇḍakaṃ tathāvijñānambalasāmarthyaṃ saptajanmāntikaṃ paśupūjayed yoginīvṛndaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ priyepiśitaṃ trividhaṃ kuryāt pakṣāmlamadhurantathāvṛkṣajā mūlajā caiva puṣpajā phalajāpi vāadvaitantu yathākhyātaṃ kartavyaṃ nānyathā na hipatanti narake ghore avīciraurave tathāyoginīgaṇamadhyasthaṃ sa paśuḥ kīrtitaṃ kulejananījāragarbhantu svaputraṃ gopayedyathāaṇimādiguṇaiśvaryasiddhiśca mānasī bhavetajñānabandhanājñeyaṃ jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vimocanampadmapatre yathā toye tathā caivaṃ na lipyatebrahmahatyādikaṃ pāpam aśvamedhādikaṃ phalametairna gṛhyate yogī kriyamāṇairapi sphuṭamniṣparigrahasantoṣaṃ dvandvayogaṃ na kārayetna carunnindayedbhadre samayādvaitameva casiddhānāṃ yoginīnāñca imañcarumpriyaṃ sadāvukapuṣpaṃ śivāmbuñca raktaśukraṃ surāntathāgandhaṃ dhūpañca geyañca tāmbūlaṃ raktavāsasamvijñānonmīlanambhadre bhavatyevaṃ nānyasevanātlaulyārthī capalā nityaṃ kulaśāstraviḍambakamkulavijñānasaṃbhogāt ṣaṇmāsāt siddhibhājanaḥprāśayet tat sadā kālaṃ yoginīmelako bhavetmukhaprakṣālanaṃ nityaṃ brahmaṇorddhagatampriyeaśītiṃ nāśayedvātān kuṣṭhavyādhintu nāśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udayārkasamastejannityaṃ vai yoginīpriyamcarukādvaitamācāraṃ mantrajaiḥ (?) saha bhojanamcarukādvaitamācāraṃ kathitaṃ jñānanirṇayamcandradvīpavinirgate ekādaśaḥ paṭalaḥbhakṣyāṇāntu samutpannaṃ punaḥ pṛcchāmi bhairavasāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi pātrāṇāṃ caryalakṣaṇamprathamaṃ bālarūpeṇa dvitīyam unmattakākṛtimsvātantraṃ pañcamaṃ devi ṣaṣṭhañca vīranāyakamtridaṇḍañcaiva deveśastathānyaṃ vedavikrayamakulañca kulaṃ jñātvā kulaṃ devyā subhāminisvaguruṃ pujayennityaṃ triṣkālaṃ bhāvitātmanaḥnivedayet prayatnena bhuktimuktijigīṣayāīpsitaṃ tu vrataṃ kuryādadvaitena samanvitampunaḥ pṛcchāmi deveśa pātrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śubhammṛnmayaṃ kūrmajaṃ devi kāṃsajaṃ tāmralohajamkaulikaṃ tu varārohe tathānyaṃ kācasambhavamviśvāmitrakapālañca sarvapātrottamaṃ priyepatiñca patitañca tadbhaveccakottamaḥ (?)etat pātramalābhena anyapātre pibet surāmkathitaṃ devi sadbhāvaṃ kimanyaṃ pṛcchase'dhunātatprasādena deveśa jñātavyaṃ jñānanirṇayamcaryāpātralakṣaṇo dvādaśaḥ paṭalaḥadhorddhañca labhejjīvo jñātvā taṃ muktibhojanamśrutvā tasya patirdivyaṃ yāti mokṣavaraṃ śubhamtaṃ jñātvā gūḍhasadbhāvaṃ sarvajñatvamprajāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śubhāśubhaṃ ca saṃbhoktaṃ na tena rahitaṃ kvacitunmanantu mano yasya tasya mokṣo bhavantīhatasya mokṣo bhavedyastu pāpapuṇyairna lipyatetasya mokṣo na sandehaḥ padmapatrāmbubinduvatpiṇḍapāte yadā devi kapālambhidyate tadācandradvīpavinirgate nyāsaḥ trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥcakradhyānavinirmuktaṃ sadyaḥ siddhikaraṃ paramśṛṇu tvamadbhutaṃ devi mahadāścaryakārakamgarndhavāḥ kinnarā yakṣā asurāśca tapodhanāḥkulabhaktivihīne tu gurubhaktivivarjitevañcakā kṛpaṇā mūḍhā hīnāni satyaninditeye dadyāstu ime śiṣyā deśiko siddhirhīyatedharme ca rataye nityaṃ krodhaye śūnyavarjitaḥdevāgniyatiyoginyā bhaktyā nityaṃ prasannadhīḥsuparīkṣya sadā tasya yo dadyāccirajīvitamyoginīnāṃ ca vidviṣṭe gurvājñālopakārakaḥna śivadūṣake devi nindake kulabhairavesāgaraṃ ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ yasya saṃcayaḥimaṃ kaulaṃ mahādevi sarvakālasya nirṇayamsamyag jñānavaraṃ devi saptā...ṇnadāpayetprathamaṃ mūlacakrantu yadānyabhyasate priyeprathamaṃ kampamāyāti dhūnanantu dvitīyakammantramudragaṇaṃ sarvaṃ durdurapluta eva saḥkālasya vañcanaṃ devi rūpasya parivartanamaṣṭau ca siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ varānane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devyāścakrorddhaṃ deveśi ādhārañcaturaṅgulamkampastobhastathā bhāṣā mudrāmutplavanantathābhūnmāgaṃ (?) khecaratvañca vaśyamākarṣaṇantathāpātālaṃ khecaratvañca acirādbhavati priyeathānyaṃ (saṃ)pravakṣyāmi brahmagranthivinirṇayamkampastobhādikaṃ bhadre bhāṣā caiva tvanekadhākālasya vañcanaṃ devi amarañca kavitvatāetatte kathitaṃ devi brahmagranthivinirṇayamūrddhaṃ romāḥ pravartante yasmiṃsthāne tu tryambakecintayet saptarātrantu pratyayaścopajāyatepurapraveśamāveśaṃ vaśyamākarṣaṇādikambalīpalitanāśañca rūpasya parivartanametatte kathitaṃ devi romakūpādi kaulikamśṛṇu tvaṃ varade nityaṃ vīrāṇāṃ vīramātaretasmiṃścittaṃ sthiraṃ kṛtvā kṣaṇārddhaṃ yāvattiṣṭhativaśyamākarṣaṇaṃ devi jarāmaraṇanāśanamuttiṣṭha khaḍgapātālaṃ dhruvaṃ sidhyati kaulikepunaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi kaulasadbhāvamuttamamtāvat samādhimāyāti stobhāveśādilakṣaṇamvarṇanā sphoṭanā vāpi purakṣobhaṃ varapradeasurī caiva deveśi vidyādharī sulocaneatītānāgatañcaiva dūrāśravaṇameva cayoginīmelakatvañca acirādbhavati sphuṭampunarāścaryaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu tvaṃ makaradhvajevadane śāstrasadbhāvaṃ svaśaktyā coditaṃ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na mṛtyurbhavate tasya akṣayo hyamaradyutiḥkruddhantu cālayeddevi trailokyasacarācaramyādṛśo bhavate siddhissatatābhyāsa eva caetaj jñānaṃ varaṃ jñānaṃ svātantrasiddhimānasīgṛhītavyaṃ prayatnena kaulave siddhimicchatārasanā ūrddhakaṃ kṛtvā manastasminniveśayetkṣaṇena mucyate rogairvyādhimṛtyujarādibhiḥkṣaṇena naśyate vyādhiḥ kaṭuke kuṣṭhanāśanamkṣīrasvādena medhāvi amaro jāyate naraḥcittaṃ dadyāntu cakreṇa nāse dadyāt vijṛmbhikādevakanyā surāṇāñca yakṣavidyādharo bhavetdivyakanyā anekāśca ākṛṣya bhuñjate priyeūrddharetā bhaved yogī na yogī karata(?) priyedurlabhantu imaṃ cakraṃ nāsti yogaṃ imamparamabhyāse tu padābhyasta mahadāścaryakārakambhavate nātra saṃdehaḥ satatābhyāsatatparāḥpratimājalpanantasmi(n) ghaṭapāṣāṇasphoṭanambrahmaviṣṇuyamendrāśca varuṇo vāyureva cagandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā nāgā vidyādharāḥ priyenakṣatratārakopetaṃ brahmāṇḍaparighaṭṭitamdarśayet svakapiṇḍaṃ satatadhyānādanekadhāabhyāsād dadate siddhiraṣṭadhā śāstracoditāsataḥ kaulamidaṃ deyaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacitetadoddharaṇaṃ gopyaṃ nityantu kṛtaniścayaḥlalāṭavarṇarāśisthaṃ lakṣaṃ kṛtya surārcite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nādaṃ pramuñcate devi mahāvegañca jāyateata ūrddhamparaṃ guhyaṃ śṛṇu tvañca parāparamabhyāsāt satataṃ vīra grāmadharmañca varjayetjarā-maraṇanirmukto nityaṃ vai yoginī priyeata ūrddhaṃ pravakṣyāmi randhrakauśalasya nirṇayammama tulyabalo bhūtvā saṃhārasṛṣṭikārakamvisarjaḥ kaulikaṃ devi tasmiṃścitte sthiraṃ sadākapālaghaṭṭikā devi nigūḍhaṃ sthāpitaṃ priyemakṣikāmaṃkṣuṇo vāpi vyāghrasiṃhagajastathāetattu kulavijñānaṃ pāramparyakramāgatamtasmāt sarvaṃ prayatnena jñātavyaṃ kulalakṣaṇamvyāpayitvā sthito deva tadvad yogīnasopamaḥ (?)na jalaṃ cintayeddevi na vahnivāyurākāśammanasya unmanībhāvo yadā bhavati sundarighaṭapaṭasthitastambhā grāmakūpādikaṃ budhaḥtāḍyamānannabodhyate jīvastallayatāṃ gataḥakṣayo hyamaro bhūtvā kāmadevadvitīyakaḥpuṣpavṛṣṭipatantasya pārijātasya sundaripañcaśrotātmakañcaiva mokṣārthaṃ codito mayāatorddhaṃ kathyate devi mudrānirṇayalakṣaṇamdvādaśānte yadā paśyet sphurantammaṇimālikāmudritampañcamudrābhiścaitanyasahitaṃ priyepañcādvādaśāntaṃ yāvac śaktyācāreṇa bhedayetlīyante khecarīcakre kṣobhayet paramāmṛtamamṛtaṃ kaulasadbhāvaṃ śṛṇu kāmakalātmakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: muktāphalasamaupamyaṃ khadyotasadṛśaṃ priyesita-raktañca kṛṣṇañca dhūmrapītañca rūpakamutpattipralayañcaiva akula-kula-varjitamsvarūpaṃ dṛśyate ...........................................kṣaṇena kurute sṛṣṭiṃ saṃhārañca varānanekodaṇḍadvayamadhyasta ....................................asminneva layaṃ bhadre samudreṇa nadī yathāpiṇḍamaṣṭaprakāreṇa aṣṭadhātupadaṃ priyeaṣṭāṣṭavidhinā cakraṃ jñātavyaṃ siddhikāraṇamkṣobhañca kulayānañca paratattvavidaḥ priyekṣīrāmbhe phenasadṛśaṃ śītalaṃ candrasannibhammucyate jvarakuṣṭhādyairvyādhisaṃghairmahātapecandradvīpavinirgate dhyānayogamudrā caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥdevatvamadya saphalaṃ tvatprasādena bhairavaadyāhaṃ kṛtakalyāṇi jñānadṛṣṭikṛtakṣamāadya me tejapiṇḍantu mahājñāna hṛdi sthitamadya me bhrāntirucchinnā tvatprasādāt surādhipayat kiñcit dṛḍhasadbhāvaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayasva mecāraṇākoṭayaḥ sapta tanmadhye pṛcchitaṃ imamtadvastu katha me nātha yenātmarakṣitaṃ tvayāatyantagahanaṃ devi sugopyaṃ rakṣitaṃ mayāasthicakrasya madhyasthaṃ sarvañcaiva susaṃsthitamvajrayogaprayogeṇa vajravadbhavate naraḥarddhakoṭigataṃ cakraṃ sahasraṃ koṭijaṃ śubhamkṣīrādā .... viplakāraiḥ pūrayettattanuṃ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcāramaṣṭapatrañca ṣoḍaśāraṃ suśobhanamaṣṭārapadmapatrañca ṣoḍaśaikaṃ varānaneṣoḍaśākṣarabhinnantu ātmā vai prāṇasaṃyutaḥcatuṣkalaṃ punardevi anyathā na kadācanakarṇikāyātmanaḥ kṛtvā ūrddhacakreṇa plāvayetdviraṣṭavarṣamātmānaṃ adhaścakre vyavasthitamplāvayet pūrvacakreṇa pūrṇacandranibhaṃ tanuplāvayitvā jagat sarvaṃ trayacakraṃ samabhyasetnalīkāyāṃ garbhalīnaṃ saṃhārantu kutaḥ priyeakṣayo hyamaro nityo yathārhantiṣṭa mānasaḥ (?)tadā'sau tiṣṭhate bhadre mayā sārddhaṃ svareśvaritadvat sa bhavate devi sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥvajravattiṣṭhata dehaṃ saṃhā(ra)ntu na hi priyeetanmayā kathitaṃ śāstre aprameyamanekadhāetatte kulasadbhāvammayā tubhyamprakāśitamcandradvīpavinirgate paramavajrīkaraṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśaḥ paṭalaḥkrīḍate mātṛmadhyasthaṃ svaśaktiṃ balagarvaitamna jñātaṃ suragāndharvaiḥ kiṃ punarbhuvi sambhavaiḥatidhyānavidaṃ deva kathyatāntu mama prabhokathyamānaṃ viśālākṣi kiṃ bhayaṃ tejabhāminisannidhāno hyahaṃ bhadre triṣkālasiddhimelakamdarśanaṃ ca bhavate tasmin mayā sārddhaṃ kuleśvarisādhvikaṃ yogasaṃyukto kāmākhyaṃ pīṭhamāsmṛtammanasā cintitaṃ rūpaṃ aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakamkathitaṃ melakaṃ sthānaṃ śrutaṃ te ceṣṭitaṃ śubham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: abhakṣyā codyate nāthe anyathā na kadācanaahaṃ sadā śiva īśaḥ śrīkaṇṭho rudra eva caahaṃ so dhīvaro devī ahaṃ vīreśvaraḥ priyesaṃharāmi jagat sarvaṃ saṃhāro'haṃ kuleśvarivihitaṃ trāyate nityaṃ vidhātā'haṃ kulāgamevicitracitratāsṛṣṭirvicitreti ca viśruteśvetapādastvahaṃ devi śvetapādeti gīyatete cāhaṃ viśrute loke bhṛṅgapādā varapradebhaṭṭapādeti vikhyāto nāmedaṃ mama sundarirūrūpādaṃ mahādevi rūdro'haṃ drāvaṇapriyetva-umātu mahādevi tubhyaṃ patirahaṃ priyetadāvatāritaṃ tubhyaṃ tattvantu ṣaṇmukhasya caavyaktaṃ gocaraṃ tena kulajātaṃ mama priyekimarthaṃ grasitā prājñā ādiṣaṇmukhasya cakiṃ varṇā dhyānamātrañca śrotumicchāmi bhairavaicchā tvaṃ jñānaśaktiśca kriyākhyā caiva bhāsiniahaṃ tvaṃ ca viśālākṣi sarvaśāstrāvatārakaḥtadā vaṭukarūpeṇa kārtikeya(ḥ) samāgataḥśāsito'haṃ mayā devi ṣaṇmukhā mṛṣakātṛkammacchamākarṣayitvā tu sphoṭitaṃ codaraṃ priyesthāpayitvā jñānapaṭṭaṃ mama gūḍhaṃ tu rakṣitamgārtaṃ kṛtvā suruṅgāya punaḥ kṣiptaṃ hi sāgaremama krodha samutpannaṃ śaktijālo mayā kṛtaḥnāgato'sau mahāmatsyā mama tulyabalaḥ priyebrahmatvaṃ hi tadā tyaktaṃ cittavī (?) dhīvarātmakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ākṛṣya tu tadā matsyaṃ śaktijālasamīkṛtaḥvadanti viditā loke paśavo jñānavarjitāḥkaivartatvaṃ kṛtaṃ yasmāt kaivarto vipranāyakaḥavyaktagocaraṃ tena kulairjātammahākṛpevighneśo nandinaścaiva mahākālasya dhīmatekālikā yoginī khyātā ūrddhato matsamaṃ priyekalpānte ca yugānte ca mama dehe tu tiṣṭhatipatraśākhāsamāyukto vṛkṣasya codbhavaṃ yathāajñānabhāvitā devi paśutvaṃ suranāyikekathitaṃ tava kāmeṣi ṣaṭmukhasya gaṇasya cabhaṭṭādyā droṇakādīnāṃ tathā ca harasiddhikābhaktiyuktā samatvena sarve śṛṇvantu kaulikamcaturyugavibhāgena avatārañcoditaṃ mayātṛtīye siddhāmṛtannāma kalau matsyodaraṃ priyeetasmād yoginīkaulānnāmnā jñānasya nirṇītaucatvāraḥ kulasiddhastu pṛcchamānā subhāvitāyogābhyāsaratānāntu raktapālasya nirṇayamṣaṭmukho vaṭuko jātāḥ kṣetrapālakulāgamevaṭukau kiṃ na vijñātau sutau tulyaṃ varānanetathyācyavanasaṃjātaṃ patitaṃ ca mahodadhautantre tantre samākhyātaṃ yathāśāpantu prāptavānkathayāmi samāsena yathā sidhyati sādhakegṛhṇa gṛhṇeti vaktavyaṃ gṛhṇāti vaṭukastathāraktāmbaraparīdhānaṃ vaṭukaṃ vighnamardakamcaturaṅgabalaṃ jitvā uṣṭānāṃ (?) stambhakārakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: imāṃ vidyāṃ jāpyaṃ kuryādbhayorddhitāyatra tatra kṣudrasiddhirbahudhā śāstracoditāpūjayettat pra(ya)tnena kaulave siddhimicchatāṣoḍaśaḥ paṭalaḥsāmprataṃ śrotumicchāmi niḥsandigdhaṃ vada prabhogūḍhaṃ guhyaṃ sanābhiñca hṛdi padmamadhomukhamnāsāgraṃ dvādaśāntaṃ ca bhruvormadhye vyavasthitamekādaśavidhaṃ proktaṃ vijñānaṃ dehamadhyataḥhṛdisthasahajo deva smaraṇārhaḥ sa ucyatesṛkāraṃ tu sadā sṛṣṭi hītyevaṃ saṃharejjagathakāramīkṣamityāhurmahārthañca gataṃ paramanyo'nyañca pravartante agnidhūmau yathā priyeśaktyābhyāsarato yogī kule sāmānyatāṃ vrajetpāramparyān mataṃ kaulaṃ karṇāt karṇagataṃ paramkṛtvā kulābhiṣekantu prakāśyaṃ tvātmanirṇayamprathamaṃ palitastambhaṃ dvitīyam īpsitaṃ bhavetpañcamantu mahāratnaṃ jarāmaraṇanāśanambhūgṛhe nirjane deśe gandhadhūpasudhūpiteparyaṅkaṃ vinyasettatra susahāyasamanvitamsugandhaṃ pūtigandhaṃ vā karpūrañcandanādiṣuatītānāgatañcaiva tasmin kālasya vañcanamadhorddhve ramate haṃso dvādaśānte layaṃ punaḥmṛṇālatantusadṛśaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitamsvayaṃ ca calate corddhvam adhañcaiva svayampunaḥjñātvā tattvamidandevi bhavabandhātmakaiḥ priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kaṇṭhasthāne dhvanirdivyā sakalā tu parāparāgudasthamudayantasyā dvādaśānte layaṃ punaḥnirlepaṃ niṣkalṃ corddhe śuddhamatyantanirmalamjñātavyaṃ gahanaṃ nātha mahājñānagataṃ paramniśvāsocchvāsasaṃyuktaṃ bhāvābhāvasamanvitamsa ātmā sa svayaṃ kartā piṇḍaṃ caiva tu saṃharetviṣādaṃ hariṣañcaiva jarāmaraṇameva cadāridrambandhanādīni piṇḍasyaiva sulocanena mohaṃ na ca vā rāgaṃ na madaṃ matsaraṃ sadāindriyāṇāmidaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtānāṃ ca varapradesa jīvaḥ pudgalo haṃsaḥ sa śivo vyāpakaḥ paraḥātmānamātmanā jñātvā bhuktimuktipradāyakābandhastu mocayed hyātmā ātmānamātmanaḥ prabhuḥātmanaścāparo devi yena jñātaṃ sa yogirāṭsuviśuddhaḥ sadā devi paṅkasthamiva paṅkajamitthambhūtaṃ parātmānaṃ yena jñātaṃ subhāminitasyocchiṣṭañca saṃprāpya bhavenmuktiḥ parā priyetena pādena saṃspṛṣṭe so'pi mokṣasya bhājanaḥtaṃ jñeyantu manaḥ kṛtvā adhikaṃ tu phalaṃ labhetcandradvīpavinirgate saptadaśaḥ paṭalaḥkaulavaṃ siddhikāmasya abhiṣekaṃ kīdṛg bhavetyavādyāśālicūrṇantu piṣṭaṃ vā godhūmodbhavamhrīṃkāramantritaṃ kṛtvā vartidvādaśabhūṣitampārśve tu pūjayet siddhāṃ yoginīṃ gurumeva caagrataḥ pūjayennityaṃ bhuñjamānāgranāyike
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yoginīmelakaṃ hyasmin bhuktimuktipradaḥ sadāraktena pūrayed raktaṃ śukrasyaiva samaṃ priyeraktaṃ vāmāmṛtaṃ śukraṃ surayā brahmamiśritammadirānandacaitanyaṃ bhaktiyukto mahātmanaḥśaṅkhasthaṃ kalaśasthaṃ vā pūjayitvā yathākramamjayādyāścauṣadhīḥ (?) sarvā mohanādyā kṛtāñjalīkṣārakṣīradadhisarpi madyode ikṣumeva cavaktrekaikaśo (?) madhye ca aṣṭau tāṃ kulaparvatāmuddhṛtya śirasi dadyāt tato yogī bhaviṣyatiraktaṃ yuktaṃ samādāya athavā citrajaṃ śubhamakṣataiḥ śālijairdirvyairanyairvāpi suśobhanaiḥdivyasugandhapuṣpaistu vicitrābharaṇabhūṣitaḥyoginī siddhavīrāṇāṃ bhavate mātṛvallabhaḥghṛtakhaṇḍasamāyuktaṃ śarkarāyāntu pūrayetcatuḥṣaṣṭiñca saudarya aṣṭau ca guṇāpi vāvīrapūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā yena tuṣyet punaḥ punaḥvaktrādvaktraṃ viśeṣeṇa siddhibhāgyaḥ samānyathāanenārabdhamātreṇa siddhiyogyo bhavettataḥiti jñānanirṇaye mahākaule candradvīpavinirgate aṣṭādaśaḥ paṭalaḥdevyāścakraṅgatāḥ sarve divyarūpasutejasaḥmokṣakāmī sadā dhyāyecchuklāmbaradharāṃ śubhāmraktāmbaradharā dhyāyedraktagandhānulepanaḥtanmadhye cātma(nā) devi tadrūpaṃ paribhāvayetśaṅkhahastā sadā dhyāyenmanasā cintitaṃ labhetpaṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gūdorddhvampīḍayennātha hṛdi kaṇṭhādikaṃ priyekapālaṃ bhedamayāti yānti jīvo nirañjanamātmānaṃ ca paraṃ vetti vettityevaṃ carācaramathānyaṃ sāmprataṃ devi pratyakṣamabhyaset sadāanāmāpīḍayedūrddhvaṃ nābhiñca hṛdayantathāātmaprāṇasamaṃ kṛtvā śaktyācārāgrasaṃsthitamṣaṭmāsādabhyaseddevi niśvāsoccaparāṅmukhāḥparadehapraveśaṃ syādabhyāsaṃ varṇitaṃ tavakulāśaktestu vīrasya tathānyaṃ śaktilakṣaṇamvyomamālinī sā bhadre khecarīti nigadyaterudraśaktistu vikhyātā kāmākhyā tu gīyatemātṛkā śabdarā(śiśca) sarvagrantheṣu kīrtyatekathayāmi samāsena vīrasya śaktilakṣaṇamdaśanaiśca jyotsnākāraiḥ surūpā cārubhāṣiṇīsurūpā sukhabhāvā ca subhruvā sulalāṭakāsuśīlā subhagā devi janānandakarā śubhāitthaṃbhūtā yadā śaktirvīrasya lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇugurukaulāgame bhaktaḥ susandhaḥ krodhavarjitaḥīdṛśī bhavate vīrā rudraśaktyā hyadhiṣṭhitābindurūpaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā sphurajjvālāvalīparaḥsujñātvā dehajaṃ śaktiṃ tadā śaktiparigrahekulakaulāgame bhakti īdṛśaṃ vīralakṣaṇamviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥkathayāmi na sandeho saṃgrahācāralakṣaṇamtasya bhedopabhedena kaulaśāstre vinirṇayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kulogho hṛdayañcaiva bhairavodyānakaṃ tathāasya madhye viniṣkrāntaṃ sambaranāma viśrutamsiddhāmṛtaṃ tu kaulaṃ mātakaulaṃ tathāparamcaturyugeṣu deveśi jñānakaulasya saṃgatiḥmeghajāñca dūrataṃ tasmin kaule vinirgatampūrṇimāyāṃ amāvasyāṃ aṣṭamī ca caturdaśīvyākhyā caiva tu kartavyā ācāryaḥ śaṅkavarjitaḥkathitaṃ kaulasadbhāvaṃ nāmnā jñānasya nirṇayeekaviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥadyāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyā tu hara siddhivināyakaḥnandīśo bhaṭṭakā caiva droṇakā ca tatha ....kaulāmṛte na saṃtṛpto ahaṃ sarve'pi bhairavabhūloke devatānāñca kathitavyaṃ kulāgamesamayācārasamopetaṃ vijñānaṃ dvaitavāsināmvatsalaḥ sarvalokānāṃ sarvajīvadayānvitaḥkulabhāvaparāḥ sarve kṛtakṛtyā surādhipāḥsaṃsārataruvistīrṇamadya chinnaṃ tvayā prabhodaśakoṭistathā cārddhaṃ nāmnā jñānasya nirṇayaḥkāmarūpe imaṃ śāstraṃ yoginīnāṃ gṛhe gṛhekurvanti satataṃ devi asya jñānaprasādataḥkāmākhye gīyate nāthe mahāmatsyodarasthitiḥcandradvīpavinirgate dvāviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥtanmamācakṣva deveśa bhaktyā jānanti bhūtalekapotikā tathā gṛdhrī haṃsī caiva nakhī tathāulukī pecakī vā tu sararī vā gūlī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāghrī hastī mayūrī ca kukuṭī na ...............tāni rūpāṇi saṃgṛhya yoginyaḥ krīḍante bhuvitadrūpaṃ kathyante ................. yuktāvadhārayetvṛścikodhyantaraścāno mūṣako darduraḥ priyeveda ......................vyādhirājānañcaiva taskarāḥanekākārarūpeṇa bhayaṃ nānāvidhaṃ viduḥevaṃ rūpaṃ samāsṛtya kṣipraṃ gṛhṇanti taṃ paśumkumārikā striyo vāpi bhāṣamāṇe kadācanapūjanīyā prayatnena kumāryaśca kulāśritaiḥpārijātodbhaveddivyairdāḍimaiḥ kusumojjvalaiḥjātyutpalakadambaiśca karṇikāraiḥ siṃhakeśaraiḥraktāmbaradharāṃ dhyāyedraktagandhānulepitāmpūjanaṃ kathitaṃ bhadre bhuktimuktiprasādhakamcandradvīpavinirgate trayoviṃśatitamaḥ paṭalaḥasurāṇāṃ surāṇāñca prabhutvamadya me prabhobhrāntisaṃsāragahanamajñānapaṭala(nta)maḥpunaḥ kathaya kauleśa dehasthaṃ siddhapūjanamkulasiddhāśca yoginyo rudrāścaiva kulādhipebahisthaṃ pūjaye..............pūjāvidhi priyecampakaiḥ kiṅkarātaiśca nīlotpalasugandhibhiḥtarujātantaśva rādeyā (?) dravyā(pi) madhumiśritāmdhūpacandanasaurabhyaṃ aguruṃ mṛganābhikamugrāṇi yāni puṣpāṇi gandhahīnaṃ na dāpayetraktāmbaradharāḥ sarve raktagandhānulepanāḥprasannavadanāścaiva pibantyo madirāsavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00027 (Bagchi-based IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
